issue.title: loop_controller.py bare except Exception: pass silently swallows ALL errors during skill regeneration
issue.actual_behavior: In src/chip_labs/transfer_surface/loop_controller.py lines 844-846, a bare except Exception: pass silently swallows ALL exceptions during skill regeneration. The comment says intelligence_server may not be available but the catch-all eats TypeError, KeyError, OSError, and every other exception with zero logging or observability.
issue.expected_behavior: Skill regeneration exceptions should be logged at debug level with full traceback (exc_info=True) so failures are observable during debugging without affecting normal operation.
repro_steps: Note the bare except Exception: pass with comment Non-fatal: intelligence_server may not be available.
This catches ALL exceptions, not just the intended connection/integration errors.
If refresh_skill() raises TypeError, KeyError, or OSError, it is silently swallowed.
No log entry, no debug output, no way to diagnose skill regeneration failures.
issue.affected_workflow: Domain chip skill regeneration in the recursive loop controller. Any exception during intelligence artifact building is silently lost, making it impossible to diagnose why skills are not regenerating properly.

evidence.before_after_proof: Before (lines 844-846): except Exception: pass with comment Non-fatal: intelligence_server may not be available. After: except Exception: logger.debug(Skill regeneration failed, exc_info=True) with comment Non-fatal: intelligence_server may be unavailable. Added import logging and logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) at module level.

proposed_fix.approach: Add import logging and logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) at module level. Replace bare except Exception: pass with except Exception: logger.debug(Skill regeneration failed (intelligence_server may be unavailable), exc_info=True). The exception is still caught (non-fatal) but now logged at DEBUG level with full traceback.
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: Existing tests pass unchanged. The fix only adds logging to an exception handler that previously did pass. Normal operation is identical. The only difference is that debug-level logging now captures the traceback.

review_claim.duplicate_notes: No existing PR addresses the silent exception swallowing in loop_controller.py skill regeneration. The fix targets lines 844-846 specifically and is independent of other loop_controller changes.
review_claim.risk_notes: Minimal risk. The change adds logging.debug() to an exception handler that previously did pass. The exception is still caught. Skill regeneration remains non-fatal. No behavioral change for normal operation. Standard library logging module, no new dependencies.
